paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Aaron Leh Atapate Namkipna
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Aaron atapate toh pi inla, puansilhte, nilhchi sathau, khelh thoihna bawngtalte, belampa nihte, tanghou silngou soh louh bawm khat toh tawi inla,
english: “Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and the bull of the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;

paite: Omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah paikhawmsak in," achi hi.
english: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the Tent of Meeting.”

paite: TOUPA'N thu apiak bang in Mosi in ahih a; omkhawmte tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kim ah a-omkhawm uhi.
english: Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Mosi in omkhawmte kiang ah, "Hiai ahi, TOUPA'N hih dia ahon thupiak pen," achi hi.
english: Moses said to the congregation, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded to be done.”

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate ahon pi a, tui in amaute asil hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.

paite: Puanak asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, puanaktual asilhsak a, siampu puanak in atuam a, siampu puanak gakna siamtak a gat in agak a, huai in agakbelh hi.
english: He put the tunic on him, tied the sash on him, clothed him with the robe, put the ephod on him, and he tied the skillfully woven band of the ephod on him and fastened it to him with it.

paite: Awmtuamna athuah a, awmtuamna ah Urim leh Thummim akoih hi.
english: He placed the breastplate on him. He put the Urim and Thummim in the breastplate.

paite: Dial akhimsak a, dial tung ah dangka-eng sikpek abulh a, huai mailam ah TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in siampu lukhu siangthou akilhbelh hi.
english: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau ala a, biakbuk leh asung a thil om teng-teng anilh a, asiangthousak chiat hi.
english: Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was in it, and sanctified them.

paite: Huai mah in sagihvei maitam atheh a, maitam leh atui-um belsuan tengteng, maiphiatna kuang leh atunna siangthousak ding in anilh hi.
english: He sprinkled it on the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all its vessels, and the basin and its base, to sanctify them.

paite: Huai sathau Aaron lu ah abuak a asianthouna ding in anilh hi.
english: He poured some of the anointing oil on Aaron’s head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate ahon pi a, puanak sungsilh tualte asilhsak a, kawnggakna in agak a, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in dial akhimsak hi.
english: Moses brought Aaron’s sons, and clothed them with tunics, and tied sashes on them, and put headbands on them, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawngtal ahon kai a, Aaron leh atapate'n khelh thoihna ding bawngtal lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

paite: Agou a; Mosi in asisan ala a, huai maitam a dia kilemna bawlna ding in akhutzung in maitam kii ah akimvel in atat a, maitam asiangsak a, maitam bul ah sisan sung in asiangthousak hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took the blood, and put it around on the horns of the altar with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it, to make atonement for it.

paite: Agilbom tengteng, asin, alap, akal nihte leh athau ala a, maitam tung ah Mosi in ahal hi.
english: He took all the fat that was on the innards, and the cover of the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat; and Moses burned it on the altar.

paite: Bawngtal pen avun toh, asa toh, a-ek toh giahphual pua ah ahal hi; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: But the bull, and its skin, and its meat, and its dung, he burned with fire outside the camp, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Haltum thillat belampa pen alan a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the ram of the burnt offering. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Agou a, Mosi in maitam sisan in akimvel in atheh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Belampa asem a, alu, asemnente leh athau ahal hi.
english: He cut the ram into its pieces; and Moses burned the head, and the pieces, and the fat.

paite: Asungkua leh akhete asil a; belampa pen maitam ah avek in ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia halmang thillat ahi a; TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: He washed the innards and the legs with water; and Moses burned the whole ram on the altar. It was a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Belampa dang, hihtuamna belampa pen ahon la nawn a, Aaron leh atapate'n belampa lutung ah akhut uh akoih uhi.
english: He presented the other ram, the ram of consecration. Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.

paite: Mosi in agou a, asisan ala a, Aaron bil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi leh akhe taklam khepi anuh hi.
english: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.

paite: Mosi in Aaron tapate api a, abil taklam dawn, akhut taklam khutpi, akhe taklam khepi anuh a, maitam sisan in akimvel ah atheh hi.
english: He brought Aaron’s sons; and Moses put some of the blood on the tip of their right ear, and on the thumb of their right hand, and on the great toe of their right foot; and Moses sprinkled the blood around on the altar.

paite: Athaute, amei thau, agilbom tengteng asin tuam pen alapte, akal nih leh athau leh aliang taklam ala hi:
english: He took the fat, the fat tail, all the fat that was on the innards, the cover of the liver, the two kidneys and their fat, and the right thigh;

paite: TOUPA ma a tanghou silngou soh louh bawm a pan tanghou silngou soh louh khat leh sathau a mek tanghou pei khat leh tanghou peipa'n khat ala a, thau tung leh aliang taklam tung ah akoih hi.
english: and out of the basket of unleavened bread that was before Yahweh, he took one unleavened cake, one cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and placed them on the fat and on the right thigh.

paite: Avek in Aaron khutpek tung ah leh atapate khutpek tung ah akoih a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat ding in avei hi.
english: He put all these in Aaron’s hands and in his sons’ hands, and waved them for a wave offering before Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in akhut a pan ala a, halmang thillat tung ah maitam ah ahal hi. Huai gimlim dia ahihtuamna ahi. TOUPA a dia mei a thillat ahi.
english: Moses took them from their hands, and burned them on the altar on the burnt offering. They were a consecration offering for a pleasant aroma. It was an offering made by fire to Yahweh.

paite: Mosi in a-awm ala a, TOUPA ma ah vei thillat in avei a; hihtuamna belampa Mosi tantuam ahi, TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiak bang in.
english: Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It was Moses’ portion of the ram of consecration, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

paite: Mosi in nilhchi sathau a pan tam lou leh maitam asisan tam lou ala a, huai in Aaron leh apuansilhte atheh a; atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng atheh hi. Aaron leh apuansilh ahihsiangthou a, atapate leh atapate puansilhte leng ahihsiangthou hi.
english: Moses took some of the anointing oil, and some of the blood which was on the altar, and sprinkled it on Aaron, on his garments, and on his sons, and on his sons’ garments with him, and sanctified Aaron, his garments, and his sons, and his sons’ garments with him.

paite: Mosi in Aaron leh atapate kiang ah, "Kihoupihna puanin kongpi bul ah sa huan unla, Aaron leh atapate'n anek ding uh ahi, chi a thu ka piak bang in, huai ah hihtuamna bawm a tanghou toh ne uhen.
english: Moses said to Aaron and to his sons, “Boil the meat at the door of the Tent of Meeting, and there eat it and the bread that is in the basket of consecration, as I commanded, saying, ‘Aaron and his sons shall eat it.’

paite: Sa leh tanghou nekbangte na hal ding uh ahi.
english: What remains of the meat and of the bread you shall burn with fire.

paite: Na kihihtuamna ni uh achin masiah kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi pawtsan lou in ni sagih na om ding uh ahi. Ni sagih sung nou hon hihtuam ding ahi ngal a.
english: You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are fulfilled: for he shall consecrate you seven days.

paite: Tuni a ahihsa bang in, nou a dia kilemna hon bawlsak ding in TOUPA'N thu apeta hi.
english: What has been done today, so Yahweh has commanded to do, to make atonement for you.

paite: Huaiziak in kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah ni sagih, sun leh zan in na om nilouh ding ua, na sihlouhna ding ua TOUPA thupiak na zuih ding uh ahi; huchibang ding a thu piak ahi,” achi hi.
english: You shall stay at the door of the Tent of Meeting day and night seven days, and keep Yahweh’s command, that you don’t die: for so I am commanded.”

paite: Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi zang a ahih ding ua thu apiak tengteng Aaron leh atapate'n ahih uhi.
english: Aaron and his sons did all the things which Yahweh commanded by Moses.
